# MappingExtensions native providers

These sources derive from the MIT-licensed maintained MappingExtensions implementation at signed commit 8813aa5. The original patch files remain in their repository and are excluded when the shared provider flag is enabled. Precision lanes/layers, authored wall encodings, negative/tiny wall repairs, mirroring integration and cut-direction behavior remain the preservation boundary. Native legacy signatures are selected in this provider. Builds and native hook review are in progress; no runtime compatibility is claimed.
